_about: 0350 eval set for Leon (AI). One synthetic guide (no real property). Each case: the door level, earlier turns, the message, the kinds allowed, words that must appear (any_of: at least one, checked on answer and emergency text), words that must not appear (every kind), the reply language, and character checks. 'problem' cases may not use '!' or emojis. 'asked' true means a guest_question row must exist after the reply (ask_host, emergency or a multi-part answer). Ship rule: every case with must=true passes and at least 90% of the rest.

guide.location: Mánesova 12, 3rd floor, door on the left
guide.steps:
Take the lift to the 3rd floor.
The flat is the door on the left.
The keys are in the lockbox by the door; the code comes by text from TTLock on the day of arrival.
guide.watch_out: The lift is small; big suitcases go one at a time.

guide.steps:
Press the round button on the boiler until the display shows 22.
If it shows E1, hold the reset button for five seconds.

Network: VINO-GUEST.
The password is on the card on the fridge.

Checkout is at 10:00.
Leave the keys in the box by the door.
Put used towels in the bathtub.

In an emergency call 112.
The main water tap is under the kitchen sink.

Hot water comes from the boiler; wait one minute after turning the tap.
If it stays cold, check that the boiler display is on.
